ingameEffects.label: Say Cheese (W-Engine Passive)
ingameEffects.description: Any squad members' Dodge Counter, EX Special Attack, Assist Attack, or Chain Attack respectively generates additional Decibels and generates Energy for the equipper. This effect can trigger once every 12s. The cooldown for each type of attack is independent of others. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This w-engine does not affect the equipper's stats.
